page_title: LEC 1-1 CAG | Lecce v Cagliari 06/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) inside the box.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Antoine Makoumbou will be replaced by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
88' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post.
86' Substitution. Gaetano Oristanio makes his way off the pitch and Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) comes on as his replacement.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) coming on for Remi Oudin.
81' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
79' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Joan Gonzalez is replaced by Alexis Blin (Lecce).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nikola Krstovic trots off the pitch and is replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Lecce).
76' The referee awards a corner and Remi Oudin (Lecce) goes over to take it.
75' Dangerous play by Matteo Prati (Cagliari). Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Lecce, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
73' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) will take the corner.
70' Substitution. Gabriel Strefezza will be replaced by Pontus Almqvist (Lecce).
69' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) heads on.

68' 1 - 1 Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) takes a great first touch inside the box after the free kick, wins himself some space and beats the goalkeeper with an accurate strike into the middle of the target.
67' It seemed like Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
67' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
65' Remi Oudin (Lecce) is adjudged offside.

64' Lecce will take a free kick near the side line. Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Davide Massa no option but to blow his whistle.

61' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Simone Scuffet. This effort really didn't trouble him.
59' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
59' Remi Oudin (Lecce) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
57' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
53' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
49' Remi Oudin (Lecce) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
49' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the right post. Very bad attempt.
49' Edoardo Goldaniga (Cagliari) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Davide Massa blows for a foul. A free kick to Lecce.
46' Referee Davide Massa blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
45' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
42' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Lecce.
40' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) whips in a cross from the corner, but Wladimiro Falcone is well positioned and punches the ball away.
38' Remi Oudin (Lecce) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
36' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) for a tough tackle.
35' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) beats his man to the lofted pass, but his header sails harmlessly well wide of the right post from close range.
34' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Cagliari.

31' 1 - 0 Goal! Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) jumps highest inside the box to meet the resulting corner from Remi Oudin. His well-placed header ends up in the top of the net, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. 1:0.
30' Remi Oudin (Lecce) prepares to take a corner kick.

29' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.
27' Davide Massa blows his whistle and signals a foul after Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) brought his opponent down.
27' Davide Massa has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marin Pongracic (Lecce).
26' Remi Oudin (Lecce) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
23' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sends a chip pass into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone is quickest to intercept the ball.
21' Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
20' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) commits a rough foul. Davide Massa stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to Cagliari, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
18' Flag up against Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
16' Remi Oudin (Lecce) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Simone Scuffet was alert and made a comfortable save.
16' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
15' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal.

14' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Matteo Prati (Cagliari) is going to have a crack himself.
12' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for an infringement.
12' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

9' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the left post, but Simone Scuffet pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
6' The linesman raises his flag. Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is adjudged offside.
6' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
6' Corner kick. Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is ready to send the ball into the box.

5' Edoardo Goldaniga (Cagliari) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Davide Massa with no other option than to blow for a foul.
5' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
3' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
2' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is caught offside!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Davide Massa was nominated as the referee for this game.
